description.label: Find code symbols and source context

locales.zh-CN: 检索代码符号与源码上下文

dev.sailry.platform.instructions: Use code_search to find symbols, code_outline for one file's structure, and code_context for bounded symbol and source context. These tools parse saved source, not types or runtime behavior; compilation and tests remain necessary for diagnostics and verification. Use existing text search, file reads, commands, builds and tests when they better match the task or structure extraction is unavailable. First outline parses only its requested file; repository search and context reconcile the current worktree index lazily. Grammar availability does not guarantee every structural capability. Report unsupported, partial and truncated results accurately. Paths are relative to the current worktree. Symbol positions use zero-based lines and UTF-8 byte columns with exclusive byte ends; snippet line numbers are one-based. Use returned file revisions when expanding source. A revision conflict requires a fresh search or outline; never reuse stale ranges against new content. Code context returns at most 20 symbols, 5 merged source snippets and 16 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Respect the Node code-index enable setting; these tools do not install or start language servers.

tools.name: code_search
tools.description: Search indexed symbols by literal query terms, optional name substring, worktree-relative path prefix and language. Default 20 results, maximum 100. Returns source ranges, full-content file revisions, index revision and partial/truncated status; first repository search lazily reconciles the worktree. This is source structure, not type analysis.

tools.name: code_outline
tools.description: Return the requested saved file's source-ordered declarations, nesting depth and limited signatures. Parses only this file when needed; complete input is limited to 1 MiB. Returns actual extraction capabilities, file/index revisions, UTF-8 source ranges and partial/truncated status. Unsupported structure is explicit.

tools.name: code_context
tools.description: Combine symbol search and revision-checked source expansion for the current worktree. Returns at most 20 symbols, 5 merged source snippets and 16 KiB of UTF-8 JSON, with file/index revisions and honest partial/truncated status. Symbol lines are zero-based; snippet lines are one-based. A changed source revision fails instead of reading a stale range.

query.description: Literal search terms for names, paths and short signatures.
